buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 4. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work: The bidder shall execute the construction work strictly as per the approved drawings, tec hnical specifications, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), and instructions issued by the competent authority. Any devi ation from the approved scope shall require prior written approval from the competent authority. 2. Site Inspection: The bidder is advised to inspect the construction site and assess the existing site conditi ons, accessibility, transportation requirements, availability of materials, and other relevant factors before s ubmitting the bid. No additional claim shall be entertained on account of failure to inspect the site or asses s the site conditions. 3. Transportation and Labour: The bidder shall arrange transportation of all construction materials, machin ery, tools, equipment, and skilled and unskilled labour required for execution of the work at their own cost. No additional payment shall be made towards transportation, labour, loading, unloading, or any other incid ental expenses. 4. Quality of Materials: All materials used in the construction shall be of good quality and conform to the re levant BIS/IS standards and approved technical specifications. All materials shall be subject to inspection a nd verification by the competent authority before use. Any substandard or rejected material shall be remo ved and replaced by the bidder at their own cost. 5. Execution as per Specifications: The construction work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with th e approved technical specifications, drawings, BOQ, applicable CPWD norms, and relevant IS codes, where ver applicable. The bidder shall ensure proper workmanship and quality of construction throughout the exe cution period. 6. Storage and Safety: The bidder shall make necessary arrangements for the safe storage of construction materials, tools, and equipment at the site. The bidder shall be solely responsible for maintaining appropri ate safety measures, cleanliness, and protection of the construction site, workers, and institute property du ring execution of the work. 7. Inspection and Verification: The competent authority shall have the right to inspect and verify the materi als, workmanship, and progress of the work at any stage of execution. The bidder shall provide all necessa ry assistance during such inspections. Any defective work or material detected shall be rectified or replace d by the bidder without any additional cost to the buyer. 8. Completion of Work: The bidder shall complete the entire construction work within the stipulated period specified in the bid/work order. Any delay attributable to the bidder shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable GeM contract conditions and provisions of the work order. 9. No Additional Charges: The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable costs, including materials, tra nsportation, labour, loading/unloading, tools, machinery, fitting, installation, taxes, and all other incidental expenses required for satisfactory completion of the work. No additional payment beyond the accepted co ntract value shall be admissible, except as expressly permitted under the contract. 10. Right to Cancel: The buyer reserves the right to cancel the bidding process, or terminate the contract i n accordance with applicable GeM rules and contractual provisions in cases of non-compliance with bid co nditions, submission of incorrect information, poor workmanship, use of substandard materials, or failure t o execute the work satisfactorily. Such decisions shall be taken by the competent authority in accordance with applicable rules. .
